address: Hogarths Stone Manor, Stone, Kidderminster, Worcestershire,DY10 4PJ
bio: Indulge in a lovely Afternoon Tea at Hogarths Stone Manor, a stunning hotel in the rural Worcestershire countryside with expansive views and decadent food.  This idyllic spot is perfect for all occasions: whether you want to toast a celebration with a sparkling Afternoon Tea, enjoy a leisurely feast to wile away the day or a big family event, complete with a bespoke Children's Afternoon Tea, Hogarths have the experience for you.  After undergoing a huge refurbishment in 2016, this Tudor-esque mansion now boasts contemporary twists. Relax in the glamorous lounge, finished with velvet furniture and luxe purple and stone grey decorations, or the upmarket and welcoming main restaurant.  The menu boasts the best of British. Start with a selection of delicate finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones and preserves, plus an array of sweet treats such as rhubarb meringue and pina colada macaroon.  Be sure to have a stroll around the 25 acres of gorgeous rolling hills, before departing for Kidderminster Rail Station, which is a scenic 15-minute drive away.
